items.q: How do I pay for my order?
items.a: In cash, on delivery: you pay the courier when your order arrives. Nothing to pay upfront.
Within 3 days of confirmation, anywhere in Tunisia. Delivery costs {deliveryFee} and is free from {threshold}.

items.q: How do I activate my ONDE product?
items.a: Send us the link you want (your Google review page, Instagram, menu…) on WhatsApp. We activate it within minutes, without touching the chip.

items.q: Can I change the destination later?
items.a: Yes, anytime. The chip's link is permanent: only the destination changes, remotely.

items.q: Is there a discount for returning customers?
items.a: Yes: after your first delivered order, you get {pct}% off your next order, recognized automatically from your phone number.
